roles.title: Chief Executive Officer
roles.purpose: Leads ACE and is accountable to the Board for safe, reliable and profitable operations. Sets strategy, approves the annual plan and the OMS, chairs the Executive Leadership Team and leads by example on HSE and integrity.
roles.oms_role_note: OMS Sponsor; Element Owner E1 Commitment and accountability

roles.title: Head of Internal Audit & Risk Assurance
roles.dotted_purpose: Administrative support; independent reporting to the Board Audit Committee
roles.purpose: Leads the risk-based internal audit programme covering financial, operational and OMS controls. Reports independently to the Board Audit Committee and maintains the corporate risk register with function owners.
roles.oms_role_note: Element Owner E10 Assurance, review and improvement; independent OMS auditor

roles.title: Manager, Strategy & Planning
roles.purpose: Leads the annual business planning cycle and the five-year strategy. Translates corporate objectives into function scorecards and reports performance against plan to the Executive Leadership Team.
roles.oms_role_note: Custodian of the ACE business plan and corporate objectives

roles.title: Internal Auditor
roles.purpose: Plans and performs audits of business processes, controls and OMS conformance. Documents findings, agrees corrective actions with owners and verifies close-out.

roles.title: Strategy & Planning Analyst
roles.purpose: Builds planning models, scenario analyses and performance dashboards. Gathers function inputs for the business plan and prepares quarterly performance reviews.

roles.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
roles.purpose: Manages the CEO's diary, correspondence and Executive Leadership Team meeting packs. Tracks actions from leadership meetings and coordinates Board meeting logistics with the Corporate Secretary.

roles.title: VP Exploration & Development
roles.purpose: Leads exploration, appraisal and field development. Accountable for the subsurface portfolio, reserves bookings, development concepts and reservoir management plans across the ACE licences.
roles.oms_role_note: Accountable for subsurface risk and reserves; contributor to E5, E6

roles.title: Development & Reservoir Manager
roles.purpose: Leads field development planning and reservoir management for producing fields. Owns production forecasts, development well targets and the annual reserves review.
roles.oms_role_note: Owner of field development plans and reservoir management plans

roles.title: Exploration Manager
roles.purpose: Manages the exploration portfolio from play evaluation to well proposal. Approves prospect risking and volumes and agrees well objectives with Wells.

roles.title: Geology Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Sets geological standards and methods across ACE and assures the quality of geological interpretations, well prognoses and geological models. Mentors geologists and endorses well geological objectives.

roles.title: Geophysics Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns seismic acquisition, processing and interpretation standards. Assures depth conversion and shallow hazard assessments used in well planning.

roles.title: Petrophysics Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Sets logging and formation evaluation requirements for wells and assures petrophysical interpretations used for reserves and completion decisions.

roles.title: Production Technology Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns well performance, artificial lift, sand management and flow assurance practices. Works with Operations to optimise well and system deliverability.

roles.title: Reservoir Engineering Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns reservoir engineering methods, simulation standards and reserves estimation practice. Assures forecasts, recovery plans and pressure surveillance programmes.

roles.title: Reserves Coordinator
roles.dotted_purpose: Reserves inputs to financial reporting
roles.purpose: Coordinates the annual reserves and resources review, maintains the reserves database and prepares disclosures for management, partners and the Ministry.

roles.title: Senior Geomodeller
roles.purpose: Builds and maintains static reservoir models used for volumes, development planning and simulation. Integrates geological, geophysical and petrophysical inputs.

roles.title: Geologist
roles.purpose: Interprets well and seismic data to map reservoirs and build geological models. Prepares well prognoses and provides wellsite geology support during drilling.

roles.title: Geophysicist
roles.purpose: Interprets seismic data, generates depth maps and supports prospect evaluation and shallow hazard studies for well sites.

roles.title: Petrophysicist
roles.purpose: Designs logging programmes, interprets log and core data and delivers formation evaluation for reserves and completion decisions.

roles.title: Production Technologist
roles.dotted_purpose: Day-to-day well optimisation support to offshore operations
roles.purpose: Monitors well performance, designs well tests and recommends interventions. Supports offshore operations with well optimisation and sand and hydrate management.

roles.title: Reservoir Engineer
roles.purpose: Runs reservoir simulation, production forecasting and decline analysis. Designs pressure surveillance and supports reserves estimates.

roles.title: Subsurface Data Coordinator
roles.dotted_purpose: Subsurface data and records management standards
roles.purpose: Loads, quality-checks and archives well, log and seismic data. Maintains the subsurface project database and data release to partners.

roles.title: VP Wells
roles.purpose: Leads drilling, completions and well intervention on the land leases and in the Gulf of Paria. Accountable for well design, well control and well integrity across the life of every ACE well, and for the performance of rig and workover contractors.
roles.oms_role_note: Accountable for well integrity and well control; contributor to E5, E6, E8

roles.title: Completions & Well Intervention Manager
roles.purpose: Manages completion design, well intervention and workover campaigns and the well integrity management system.

roles.title: Drilling Manager
roles.purpose: Manages well planning and drilling operations. Approves well programmes, manages the rig contract and leads well control readiness.
roles.oms_role_note: Approver of well programmes and drilling-related deviations

roles.title: Completions Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns completion and intervention design standards, completion equipment qualification and sand control practice.

roles.title: Drilling Engineering Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns well design and drilling engineering standards including casing design, well control and barrier requirements. Endorses well programmes before approval.

roles.title: Well Integrity Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns the well integrity standard, barrier verification and annulus management. Assures that every well remains within its operating envelope and approves well integrity deviations.

roles.title: Drilling Supervisor (Wellsite)
roles.purpose: Represents ACE on the land or offshore rig, directs drilling and workover contractor operations against the approved programme and enforces well control and permit requirements.
roles.oms_role_note: ACE representative at the wellsite; well control authority on the rig

roles.title: Completions Engineer
roles.purpose: Designs completions and intervention programmes and supervises completion equipment preparation and installation.

roles.title: Drilling Engineer
roles.purpose: Prepares well designs and drilling programmes, selects equipment and services and supports operations during execution.

roles.title: Fluids & Cementing Engineer
roles.purpose: Designs drilling fluid and cementing programmes, reviews cement evaluation results and manages fluids service contractors.

roles.title: Well Integrity Engineer
roles.dotted_purpose: Annulus monitoring and barrier testing with offshore operations
roles.purpose: Maintains well integrity records, analyses annulus pressures and plans barrier tests and integrity remediation.

roles.title: Well Services Coordinator
roles.purpose: Coordinates well services equipment, contractor mobilisation and logistics for drilling and intervention campaigns.

roles.title: Wells Planning & Cost Engineer
roles.dotted_purpose: Cost estimating and planning standards
roles.purpose: Prepares well time and cost estimates, AFEs and schedules and tracks actual costs against approved budgets.

roles.title: Wells Administrator
roles.purpose: Provides administrative support to the Wells team, tracks service orders and invoices, and maintains well files and daily reports.

roles.title: VP Engineering & Projects
roles.purpose: Leads capital projects and engineering. Accountable for engineering standards and technical integrity across ACE through the discipline leads, who report on a dotted line to this role via the Technical Leadership Council.
roles.oms_role_note: Element Owner E6 Asset design and integrity; Chair, Technical Leadership Council

roles.title: Manager, Technical Excellence
roles.purpose: Manages the engineering standards framework, technical deviation process and discipline lead network. Coordinates the Technical Leadership Council and the technical assurance programme.
roles.oms_role_note: Secretary, Technical Leadership Council; owner of the engineering standards set

roles.title: Projects Manager
roles.purpose: Leads the project portfolio from concept to handover. Runs the stage-gate process and is accountable for project safety, cost, schedule and quality.
roles.oms_role_note: Owner of the capital project delivery process and stage gates

roles.title: Cost & Planning Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns cost estimating, scheduling and project controls standards and assures estimates used in investment decisions.

roles.title: Electrical Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns electrical design, hazardous area classification and electrical safety standards, and endorses electrical changes.

roles.title: Fire & Gas and Safety Systems Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns fire and gas detection, emergency shutdown, active and passive fire protection standards and their performance standards.
roles.oms_role_note: Technical Authority - Fire & Gas and Safety Systems

roles.title: Instrumentation & Control Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns instrumentation, control system and alarm management standards, and the safety instrumented system life cycle.

roles.title: Materials & Corrosion Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns materials selection, corrosion management and chemical injection strategy. Sets corrosion monitoring requirements and endorses materials substitutions.

roles.title: Metering & Measurement Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns fiscal and allocation metering standards, meter verification and measurement uncertainty, working with Finance on hydrocarbon accounting.

roles.title: Pipelines Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns pipeline design, integrity and pigging standards for the Gulf of Paria pipelines, land flowlines and gathering lines.

roles.title: Piping Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns piping design, layout, stress and specification standards and endorses piping changes and repairs.

roles.title: Process Engineering Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns process design standards, heat and material balances, relief and blowdown philosophy and operating envelopes. Endorses process-related MOCs.

roles.title: Static Mechanical Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns standards for pressure vessels, heat exchangers, tanks and pressure equipment design and fitness for service.

roles.title: Structural & Civil Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns structural and civil standards for platforms and onshore facilities, including structural integrity management and weight control.

roles.title: Subsea Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns subsea equipment and risers standards and the subsea inspection and integrity strategy.

roles.title: Project Manager
roles.purpose: Manages assigned capital projects through the stage gates, leads the project team and contractors and reports safety, cost and schedule performance.

roles.title: Electrical Engineer
roles.purpose: Designs and reviews electrical systems, protection studies and hazardous area documentation.

roles.title: Instrumentation & Control Engineer
roles.purpose: Engineers control and safety system changes, maintains cause and effect documentation and supports alarm rationalisation.

roles.title: Mechanical Engineer
roles.purpose: Performs mechanical design and fitness-for-service assessments for pressure equipment and supports project engineering.

roles.title: Pipeline Engineer
roles.purpose: Supports pipeline integrity assessments, pigging programmes and pipeline modifications.

roles.title: Process Engineer
roles.purpose: Performs process design and simulation, reviews operating data and supports MOC and debottlenecking studies.

roles.title: Project Controls Analyst
roles.purpose: Maintains project schedules and cost reports, tracks progress and forecasts final cost.

roles.title: Project Engineer
roles.purpose: Coordinates engineering deliverables, interfaces and technical queries on assigned projects and prepares handover documentation.

roles.title: Structural Engineer
roles.purpose: Performs structural assessments of platforms and onshore structures, supports weight control and plans structural inspections.

roles.title: CAD Designer
roles.purpose: Produces and updates engineering drawings and models, including as-built updates following modifications.

roles.title: Engineering Document Controller
roles.dotted_purpose: Document control standards and repository rules
roles.purpose: Registers, numbers and distributes engineering drawings and documents, manages transmittals and maintains the as-built register.

roles.title: VP Operations
roles.purpose: Leads offshore, land, processing and maintenance operations. Accountable for safe, compliant and reliable production, control of work and the execution of asset integrity activities.
roles.oms_role_note: Element Owner E7 Plans and procedures and E8 Execution of activities

roles.title: Land Operations Manager
roles.purpose: Manages production from ACE's land leases in Central and South Trinidad, including well pads, pump jacks, gathering stations and flowlines. Accountable for land production, control of work, landowner interfaces and lease emergency preparedness.
roles.oms_role_note: Area Authority - Land leases, well pads, gathering stations and flowlines

roles.title: Maintenance & Integrity Manager
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical integrity standards and performance standards
roles.purpose: Manages maintenance, inspection and integrity execution for all assets. Accountable for safety-critical element maintenance compliance and the backlog.
roles.oms_role_note: Owner of the maintenance and inspection programmes for safety-critical elements

roles.title: Offshore Operations Manager (Gulf of Paria)
roles.purpose: Manages offshore production in the Gulf of Paria across Pommerac A and the unmanned wellhead platforms. Accountable for production targets, control of work and offshore emergency preparedness.
roles.oms_role_note: Area Authority - Chenet B and Sapodilla C unmanned platforms and the Gulf of Paria pipelines

roles.title: Plant Manager - Central Processing Facility
roles.purpose: Manages the Central Processing Facility, which processes crude and gas from the offshore and land fields. Accountable for site safety, permits, sales gas delivery to the Gas Buyer, crude storage and liftings, and emergency preparedness.
roles.oms_role_note: Area Authority - Central Processing Facility, crude tank farm and loading jetty

roles.title: Inspection Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns the written schemes of examination and inspection standards, and assures inspection results and anomaly assessments.

roles.title: Maintenance Superintendent
roles.purpose: Leads maintenance execution teams offshore and onshore, plans resources and assures quality of maintenance work.

roles.title: Offshore Installation Manager
roles.purpose: Has overall responsibility for the safety of personnel and operations on Pommerac A during the hitch. Authorises permits, leads emergency response on the installation and manages the offshore crew.

roles.title: Production Chemistry Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns production chemistry standards including chemical selection, injection, water and gas quality and laboratory practice.

roles.title: Reliability & Maintenance Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns maintenance strategy, reliability analysis and CMMS data standards, including criticality assessment and safety-critical element strategies.

roles.title: Rotating Equipment Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns standards for compressors, pumps, turbines and generators, including condition monitoring and overhaul strategy.

roles.title: Field Supervisor (Land)
roles.purpose: Supervises lease operators across the land leases, plans daily field work and acts as permit issuer for well pad and gathering station work.

roles.title: Offshore Production Supervisor
roles.purpose: Supervises the production crew on shift, coordinates process operations and maintenance activities and acts as permit issuer.

roles.title: Shift Supervisor (CPF)
roles.purpose: Leads the shift crew at the Central Processing Facility, coordinates operations and acts as permit issuer and incident controller on shift.

roles.title: Crude Loading & Custody Transfer Coordinator
roles.dotted_purpose: Custody transfer metering
roles.purpose: Plans and supervises crude tanker and barge liftings, custody transfer measurement and loading documentation with buyers and inspectors.

roles.title: Inspection Engineer
roles.purpose: Plans and reviews inspections, evaluates results and raises anomalies for integrity assessment.

roles.title: Integrity Engineer
roles.dotted_purpose: Corrosion management standards
roles.purpose: Manages integrity data, risk-based inspection and corrosion monitoring and tracks anomalies to resolution.

roles.title: Laboratory Chemist
roles.purpose: Performs gas, condensate and water analyses, maintains laboratory equipment and supports chemical treatment programmes.

roles.title: Maintenance Planner
roles.purpose: Plans and schedules preventive and corrective maintenance, prepares work packs and manages the maintenance backlog.

roles.title: Operations Engineer (CPF)
roles.purpose: Provides engineering support to the Central Processing Facility, monitors performance and supports MOCs and troubleshooting.

roles.title: Operations Engineer (Land)
roles.purpose: Provides engineering support to land operations, optimises artificial lift and gathering systems and supports MOCs.

roles.title: Operations Engineer (Offshore)
roles.purpose: Provides engineering support to offshore operations, prepares operating instructions, analyses trips and supports MOCs.

roles.title: Operations Training & Competence Coordinator
roles.dotted_purpose: Competence assurance framework
roles.purpose: Maintains the operations competence matrix, schedules training and assessments and tracks verification of competence.

roles.title: Permit to Work Coordinator (CPF)
roles.purpose: Prepares and coordinates permits and isolations at the Central Processing Facility and audits permit-to-work compliance.

roles.title: Permit to Work Coordinator (Offshore)
roles.purpose: Prepares and coordinates permits and isolations on Pommerac A and audits permit-to-work compliance.

roles.title: Production Data Analyst
roles.dotted_purpose: Data standards and platforms
roles.purpose: Maintains production data, daily and monthly production reports and allocation inputs for Finance and partners.

roles.title: Reliability Engineer
roles.purpose: Analyses equipment failures, leads root cause analyses and optimises maintenance strategies.

roles.title: CMMS Administrator
roles.purpose: Maintains equipment hierarchy, maintenance plans and work order data quality in the maintenance management system.

roles.title: Control Room Operator (CPF)
roles.purpose: Operates the Central Processing Facility from the control room, monitors alarms, crude and sales gas quality and responds to upsets.

roles.title: Control Room Operator (Offshore)
roles.purpose: Operates the process from the central control room, monitors alarms and responds to process upsets and emergencies.

roles.title: Corrosion Technician
roles.purpose: Collects corrosion coupons and probe data, performs thickness surveys and supports chemical injection checks.

roles.title: Deck & Crane Operator
roles.dotted_purpose: Marine and lifting operations standards
roles.purpose: Operates the platform crane, manages deck cargo and supports supply vessel and helicopter operations.

roles.title: Electrical & Instrument Technician
roles.purpose: Maintains, tests and calibrates electrical, instrument, control and safety systems, including safety-critical function testing.

roles.title: Field Operator (CPF)
roles.purpose: Performs field rounds, equipment start-ups and shutdowns, isolations, tank gauging and sampling at the Central Processing Facility.

roles.title: Lease Operator
roles.purpose: Operates and checks wells, pump jacks, separators and tank batteries on the land leases, gauges tanks, takes samples and reports leaks and abnormal conditions.

roles.title: Marine & Helideck Coordinator
roles.dotted_purpose: Marine and aviation logistics
roles.purpose: Coordinates vessel and helicopter movements, manages the helideck crew and maintains personnel-on-board records.

roles.title: Mechanical Technician
roles.purpose: Maintains and repairs rotating and static mechanical equipment in line with work orders and procedures.

roles.title: Offshore Medic
roles.dotted_purpose: Clinical governance and occupational health standards
roles.purpose: Provides medical care and first response offshore, manages the sick bay and supports health surveillance.

roles.title: Operations Administrator
roles.purpose: Supports the operations leadership team with reporting, travel, manning schedules and administration.

roles.title: Operations Document Controller
roles.dotted_purpose: Document control standards and repository rules
roles.purpose: Controls operating procedures, work instructions and site documentation, ensuring the current approved revision is available at each location.

roles.title: Pipeline & Gathering Technician
roles.dotted_purpose: Pipeline integrity and pigging standards
roles.purpose: Maintains flowlines and gathering lines, runs pigs, patrols rights of way and supports leak response.

roles.title: Production Technician (Offshore)
roles.purpose: Operates and monitors process and utility equipment, performs routine checks, isolations and sampling, and visits the unmanned platforms.

roles.title: VP HSE & Compliance
roles.purpose: Leads HSE, process safety, emergency response, security and compliance. Owns the OMS framework and the HSE policy and advises the CEO on HSE risk.
roles.oms_role_note: Element Owner E2 Policies, standards and objectives; E5 Risk assessment and control; E9 Monitoring, reporting and learning

roles.title: Compliance & Assurance Manager
roles.purpose: Manages the OMS conformance programme, HSE audits and regulatory compliance tracking.

roles.title: Emergency Response & Security Manager
roles.purpose: Manages emergency and crisis preparedness, drills and exercises, oil spill response arrangements and site security.
roles.oms_role_note: Owner of the emergency response and crisis management plans

roles.title: HSE Manager
roles.purpose: Leads the HSE advisory, environmental and occupational health teams, sets the annual HSE plan and manages incident investigation.

roles.title: Environmental Lead
roles.dotted_purpose: Technical Leadership Council (chaired by VP Engineering & Projects)
roles.purpose: Owns environmental standards, permits, emissions and discharge monitoring and environmental impact assessments.

# Acme Caribbean Energy (ACE) — Company Profile

*Fictional reference company created by Cynmark Systems Limited for demonstration projects (OMS document publishing, supply chain, and others). All people, assets and lease names are invented. Profile as at 21 November 2026.*

---

## 1. Overview

Acme Caribbean Energy Limited (ACE) is a mid-size Trinidad and Tobago crude oil and natural gas producer with about **300 staff**. It was formed in 2004 and has grown by taking on mature land leases and small offshore fields that larger operators no longer prioritised.

ACE does three things:

- **Produces** crude oil and gas from small offshore fields in the **Gulf of Paria** and from **land leases** in Central and South Trinidad.
- **Processes** all of its production at its own **Central Processing Facility (CPF)** in Central Trinidad.
- **Sells** gas to **the Gas Buyer** (the national gas buyer; deliberately unnamed) under a gas sales agreement, and sells crude to buyers, shipped by tanker or barge from the CPF jetty.

ACE is the operator on its licences and has joint venture partners on some of them.

---

## 2. Where ACE operates

| Location | What is there | Who runs it |
|---|---|---|
| **Head Office**, Central Trinidad, close to the highway | Executive, technical and support functions (about 190 staff) | Facilities & Administration Manager |
| **Point Lisas Shore Base** | Quayside, warehouse and laydown yard. Supply boats and crew boats leave from here for the Gulf of Paria | Logistics & Materials Manager |
| **Pommerac A**, Gulf of Paria | Small manned production platform: separation, metering, export, accommodation and helideck | Offshore Installation Manager (two, on rotation) |
| **Chenet B** and **Sapodilla C**, Gulf of Paria | Normally unmanned wellhead platforms tied back to Pommerac A | Offshore Operations Manager (Gulf of Paria) |
| **Gulf of Paria pipelines** | Subsea lines carrying crude and gas to the west coast and the CPF | Offshore Operations Manager (Gulf of Paria) |
| **Tamarind Lease** (Central), **Pawpaw Lease** and **Soursop Lease** (South) | Land wells on pump jacks, well pads, tank batteries, gathering stations and flowlines | Land Operations Manager |
| **Central Processing Facility**, Central Trinidad, west coast | Crude stabilisation and storage, gas conditioning and compression, sales gas metering to the Gas Buyer, crude tank farm and loading jetty | Plant Manager – Central Processing Facility |
| **Contracted rigs** | Land drilling and workover rigs, and a jack-up for offshore campaigns | Drilling Supervisors (Wellsite) |

### How product moves

```
Reservoirs → Wells (land & offshore) → Pommerac A / well pads & gathering stations
          → Gulf of Paria pipelines / land flowlines → Central Processing Facility
          → Sales gas to the Gas Buyer  |  Crude stored and shipped by tanker or barge
```

### How materials move

```
Suppliers → Point Lisas Shore Base (warehouse) → Supply boats → Gulf of Paria platforms
                                              → Road transport → Land leases and CPF
```

---

## 3. Organisation

ACE is led by a **Chief Executive Officer** with an Executive Leadership Team of **12 VPs** (the CFO sits at VP level). Strategy & Planning and Internal Audit & Risk Assurance report directly to the CEO.

| Function | Head | Staff | Main purpose |
|---|---|---:|---|
| CEO Office | Satesh Sankar, CEO | 8 | Direction, strategy, internal audit |
| Exploration & Development | Anya Joseph | 22 | Geoscience, reservoir management, reserves |
| Wells | Joanne Ho Sing | 20 | Drilling, completions, workovers, well integrity |
| Engineering & Projects | Dev Jaggernauth | 34 | Capital projects, engineering standards, technical integrity |
| Operations | Sophia Hosany | 109 | Offshore, land and CPF operations; maintenance and integrity |
| HSE & Compliance | George Habib | 22 | HSE, process safety, emergency response, security, OMS assurance |
| Finance | Teresa Daniel, CFO | 16 | Accounting, planning, tax, treasury, JV accounting |
| Human Resources | Adrian Achong | 12 | People, competence assurance, industrial relations |
| Supply Chain Management | Sasha George | 18 | Procurement, contracts, logistics, shore base, materials |
| IT, Data & Knowledge | Marvin Williams | 14 | IT/OT, data, document control and knowledge management |
| Business Development & Markets | Karen Jack | 8 | Gas sales to the Gas Buyer, crude marketing, partners, new ventures |
| Communications & Corporate Services | Rodney Garcia | 10 | Communications, community relations, offices |
| Legal & Government Affairs | Sharda Bissoon | 7 | Legal, corporate secretary, licences, government relations |

**Grades:** L1 Chief Executive · L2 Vice President · L3 Manager · L4 Lead / Superintendent · L5 Senior Professional / Supervisor · L6 Professional / Specialist · L7 Technician / Administrative.

**Workforce mix:** 150 women and 150 men (7 of the 12 VPs are women). Names reflect Trinidad's mix of African, East Indian, French Creole, Portuguese, Chinese and Syrian-Lebanese heritage. Most professionals trained at Saman University or the Lisas Institute of Technology, with some at universities in the UK, USA and Canada. Technicians come through the Lisas Institute of Technology, Southern Technical Institute and Caroni Technical Institute.

**Operations** is the largest function and is split four ways:

- **Offshore Operations (Gulf of Paria):** Pommerac A crews on 14/14 rotation, plus visits to the unmanned platforms.
- **Land Operations:** field supervisors, lease operators and pipeline & gathering technicians working across the leases.
- **Central Processing Facility:** shift crews, laboratory, and crude loading & custody transfer.
- **Maintenance & Integrity:** planners, mechanical and E&I technicians, inspection, integrity and reliability engineering.

---

## 4. The cross-functional structure

An oil and gas company cannot be run through its reporting lines alone. ACE's chart has **two kinds of line**.

### Solid lines: who you work for

Every employee has one line manager in one function. Solid lines decide day-to-day priorities, performance reviews and budgets.

### Dotted lines: who sets your technical standard

ACE has **32 discipline leads**. Each one:

- lives in the function where the work happens (a solid line), and
- holds a **dotted line to the VP Engineering & Projects** through the **Technical Leadership Council (TLC)**, which the VP chairs. Elena Farfan (Manager, Technical Excellence) acts as secretary.

Each discipline lead is the **Technical Authority** for the discipline. They own its standards, endorse changes (MOCs), approve technical deviations and assure the quality of the work, whichever function does it.

| Home function | Discipline leads |
|---|---|
| Engineering & Projects (12) | Process, Static Mechanical, Piping, Pipelines, Structural & Civil, Electrical, Instrumentation & Control, Fire & Gas and Safety Systems, Materials & Corrosion, Subsea, Metering & Measurement, Cost & Planning |
| Exploration & Development (5) | Geology, Geophysics, Petrophysics, Reservoir Engineering, Production Technology |
| HSE & Compliance (4) | Process Safety, Environmental, Occupational Health & Hygiene, Human Factors |
| Operations (4) | Rotating Equipment, Inspection, Reliability & Maintenance, Production Chemistry |
| Wells (3) | Drilling Engineering, Completions, Well Integrity |
| IT, Data & Knowledge (2) | Information Management, Telecoms & OT Cyber Security |
| Supply Chain Management (2) | Marine, Quality |

This is why **Engineering & Projects sits at the centre** of the ACE map. It is a mid-size function (34 people), but every technical line in the company runs through it.

### Area Authority and Technical Authority

Two kinds of authority cross the organisation and appear throughout ACE's procedures:

- **Area Authority:** the person responsible for everything that happens at a location. That's the OIMs for Pommerac A, the Offshore Operations Manager for the unmanned platforms and pipelines, the Land Operations Manager for the leases, and the Plant Manager for the CPF. They issue permits and release work.
- **Technical Authority:** the discipline lead who decides whether something is technically acceptable. They endorse designs, changes and deviations.

Many of ACE's procedures depend on these two agreeing. MOC, permit to work and deviation control are examples.

### Key working relationships

| Relationship | What flows between them |
|---|---|
| Exploration & Development ↔ Wells | Well proposals, subsurface targets, wellsite geology, logging and results |
| Engineering & Projects ↔ Operations | Technical authority endorsement, MOC, safety-critical elements, project handover |
| Engineering & Projects ↔ Supply Chain | Technical specifications, vendor qualification, inspection and test plans |
| Operations ↔ HSE & Compliance | Permit to work, incident investigation, emergency and oil spill response |
| Operations ↔ Supply Chain | Spares, maintenance contracts, supply boats from Point Lisas |
| Operations ↔ Business Development & Markets | Sales gas delivery to the Gas Buyer, crude liftings and quality |
| Wells ↔ Supply Chain | Land and offshore rig, workover and well services contracts |
| HSE & Compliance ↔ Supply Chain | Contractor HSE pre-qualification and performance |
| HSE & Compliance ↔ IT, Data & Knowledge | OMS documents, tagging and publishing |
| Business Development & Markets ↔ Legal | Gas sales and joint venture agreements, licence bids |

The full list of 31 relationships is in the workbook's *Cross-Functional Links* tab.

---

## 5. ACE's Operating Management System (OMS)

ACE structures its management system on **IOGP Report 510, *Operating Management System Framework* (2014), IOGP / IPIECA**. The ten elements each have an owner on the Executive Leadership Team.

| Element | Owner |
|---|---|
| E1 Commitment and accountability | Satesh Sankar, CEO |
| E2 Policies, standards and objectives | George Habib, VP HSE & Compliance |
| E3 Organisation, resources and capability | Adrian Achong, VP Human Resources |
| E4 Stakeholders and customers | Rodney Garcia, VP Communications & Corporate Services |
| E5 Risk assessment and control | George Habib, VP HSE & Compliance |
| E6 Asset design and integrity | Dev Jaggernauth, VP Engineering & Projects |
| E7 Plans and procedures | Sophia Hosany, VP Operations |
| E8 Execution of activities | Sophia Hosany, VP Operations |
| E9 Monitoring, reporting and learning | George Habib, VP HSE & Compliance |
| E10 Assurance, review and improvement | Nicole Lange, Head of Internal Audit & Risk Assurance |

*Element titles from IOGP Report 510 (2014), © IOGP and IPIECA, reproduced with acknowledgement.*

### The OMS roles that keep it working

| Role | Holder | What they do for the OMS |
|---|---|---|
| OMS Manager | Marissa Bobb | Custodian of the framework and its mapping to IOGP 510; runs conformance assessments |
| Compliance & Assurance Manager | Dillon Haddad | OMS and HSE audit programme |
| Information Management Lead | Sanjay Jagessar | Owns document control standards and the controlled repository; **gatekeeper** for what becomes an official ACE document |
| Technical Writer / Procedures Specialist | Ryan Ramsaran | Drafts and edits to the ACE templates; supports authors with structure, styles and OMS tags |
| Document Controllers | Allison St. Hill, Paul Gomes (IT, Data & Knowledge); Sanjay Greenidge, Anil Ramdass (Engineering); Curtis Bobb (Operations) | Register, check, publish and revise controlled documents |
| Discipline leads (Technical Authorities) | 32 people | Own the technical standards that make up much of the document set |

### The document problem ACE is trying to solve

ACE's management system is very document-heavy, especially for **asset integrity and engineering excellence**: engineering standards, written schemes of examination, performance standards, procedures and work instructions.

In most companies the link between those documents and the OMS is kept **outside** the documents, in a conformance matrix or a separately built OMS web portal. It falls out of date as soon as documents are revised. Over time staff stop trusting the portal and go back to searching for PDFs, and the OMS context is lost. Many companies end up with documents in SharePoint folders and no OMS view at all.

ACE's approach, under its **Operational Document Publishing Standard**, is to keep the OMS context **inside the approved Word documents**:

1. **OMS tags** under the title and each heading say which IOGP 510 expectations that section addresses.
2. **Semantic paragraph styles** mark requirements, responsibilities, risk controls, warnings, approval gates and record requirements.
3. **Document metadata** records the owner, function, process and role register.

Authors simply produce a properly formatted document. A reader program then builds the web views automatically:

- an OMS wheel by element
- a network map of documents
- coverage and gap views
- views by role and by function

An **auditor** checks every document at the gateway: missing tags, invalid tag numbers, "shall" statements not styled as requirements, missing metadata.

The Information Management Lead's gatekeeper role remains, because someone must own the nomenclature. Automated checks, and later AI-suggested tagging, reduce that role from hours of manual work per document to a review.

The demo is planned for **oms.cynmark.app**.

---

## 6. Using ACE in other projects

ACE is designed to be reused. Some useful anchors for other projects:

- **Supply chain:**
  - Point Lisas Shore Base, supply boats and crew boats to the Gulf of Paria, road logistics to the leases and the CPF.
  - Rig, workover and well services contracts.
  - Contractor HSE pre-qualification and local content commitments.
  - An 18-person SCM function with Procurement, Contracts, and Logistics & Materials teams, plus Marine and Quality discipline leads.
- **Commercial:** a gas sales agreement with the Gas Buyer, crude sales and liftings, joint venture partners and partner billing.
- **Asset integrity:** platforms, pipelines, land flowlines, tank farm, rotating equipment, safety-critical elements, inspection and corrosion programmes.
- **People and competence:** 300 named staff with grades, degrees, hire dates and job descriptions; offshore rotation and shift patterns; a recognised union.

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| **ACE_Organisation.xlsx** | People (300), Functions, Discipline Leads, Cross-Functional Links, OMS Element Owners, Assets, Locations and Grades. Counts are live formulas |
| **ACE_People.csv** | The People tab as CSV, for reuse in other tools |
| **ACE_Org_Chart.html** | Self-contained interactive org chart: cross-functional map, reporting tree, discipline leads and people search. Opens offline in any browser |
| **ACE_Company_Profile.md** | This document |

**To update the chart:**

1. Edit the People tab in the workbook.
2. Save the People tab as **CSV UTF-8**.
3. Open the org chart and click **Load CSV**, or drop the file on the page.

The chart recalculates headcounts and reporting lines, and runs a data check. The check flags duplicate IDs, unknown function codes, and managers or dotted lines pointing at IDs that don't exist. Keep the column headers unchanged.

CI-REG-001.title: Bundle offshore inspections into platform campaigns
CI-REG-001.source_ref: Inspections done by the original due date below 90% for Q2 and Q3 2024
CI-REG-001.kpi: Offshore inspections done by the original due date, %
CI-REG-001.notes: Median offshore wait for transport went from 17.7 to 15.1 days and inspections done after the due date without an approved deferral almost disappeared. Offshore trips fell from 91 in 2024 to 35 in Jan–Nov 2026; logistics saving about USD 771,000 a year at public helicopter and boat rates. Side effect seen later: offshore deferrals rose from 17% (2024) to 22% (2025) as items were pushed to the next campaign — see CI-2026-007.

CI-REG-001.title: Confirm site readiness 48 hours before travel
CI-REG-001.source_ref: Idea from the OIM after three wasted trips in August 2024
CI-REG-001.notes: Folded into Rev 02 of the process with the campaign change.

CI-REG-001.title: Standard deferral safeguards template with expiry tracking
CI-REG-001.source_ref: Line 2 conformance check: C-AIM-004 rated Degraded (deferral safeguards not recorded on 3 of 8 samples)
CI-REG-001.kpi: Deferrals with safeguards and expiry recorded, %
CI-REG-001.notes: Do stage: template trialled at Pommerac A; extension rule awaiting MOC-2026-061.

CI-REG-001.title: Stop campaign bundling from driving deferrals of critical lines
CI-REG-001.source_ref: EV-2026-161 pinhole leak on PL-101 (deferral extended; C-AIM-004 failed)
CI-REG-001.notes: Analyse stage. Data: deferral rate 17% (2024), 22% (2025), 15% (2026). Proposal: criticality-A items get a dedicated trip if the next campaign is past the due date.

CI-REG-001.title: Join MOC implementation to the weekly maintenance schedule
CI-REG-001.source_ref: MOCs open at month end above 20 for two quarters (MOC-OPEN)
CI-REG-001.notes: Step detail and lane changed within the process (PRS pair revision, no MOC needed under ACE-BPM-PRA-003 §6).

CI-REG-001.title: Complete change packages before approval
CI-REG-001.source_ref: Annual process review 2025: 15% of changes returned at approval
CI-REG-001.notes: Checklist added to the MOC module; awaiting standardisation in ACE-MOC-PRC-001 Rev 02.

CI-REG-001.title: Shorten the Technical Authority review queue
CI-REG-001.source_ref: MOC cycle time median above 30 days for C2 and C3 changes
CI-REG-001.kpi: Median days at Technical Authority review (S04)
CI-REG-001.notes: Measure stage: 90% of S04 time is waiting; three discipline leads hold 70% of reviews.

CI-REG-001.title: Raise MOC requests from a phone on site
CI-REG-001.source_ref: Idea from an offshore operations engineer
CI-REG-001.kpi: Days from change identified to MOC raised
CI-REG-001.notes: Route chosen: just do it within the ONE MOC module.

processes.title: Inspection Planning and Execution Process
processes.summary: The repeating cycle that keeps equipment inspected on time: scope from the risk-based inspection plan, decide whether a deferral is needed, plan the work, move people and equipment to site, inspect, assess the results and set the next due date. Physical and cyclical: crews and equipment travel by helicopter and boat to the offshore platforms.

cycle.name: Inspection cycle
cycle.label: Next inspection falls due
cycle.period: Set by the RBI interval (12 to 48 months)

steps.name: Can it be done by the due date?
Endorse deferral with safeguards
steps.threshold: Deferral periods by residual risk band (ACE-RSK-POL-001 section 4): 180, 90 or 30 days; one extension only

steps.name: Raise work order and work pack
Update RBI and set next due date

flows.carries: NDT crew by helicopter to the platform
NDT equipment by supply boat from Point Lisas
Anomaly to the Anomaly Management Process
Updated RBI and history for the next cycle

kpis.name: Days from due notice to closed cycle (median)
Inspections done by the original due date
Controls in the process that are effective
Cases that followed the modelled path

value.explain: An inspection protects production. While an item is overdue or deferred, the chance of a loss of containment rises; the cost of waiting is days at risk × added chance of failure ÷ 365 × shutdown days × site production × oil price. Trips cost a helicopter round trip each (shared by everyone on board) plus boat time for equipment.

history.summary: First modelled issue, drawn from ACE-AIM-PRA-001 and ACE-AIM-STD-002. Each offshore inspection booked as its own trip.
Campaign bundling: offshore inspections due within 60 days on the same platform are grouped into one trip, and site readiness is confirmed 48 hours before travel.

processes.title: Management of Change Process
processes.summary: How a proposed change to plant, process, people, procedures or organisation is raised, classified, assessed, approved, implemented, verified and closed. Information-heavy: the work is mostly records, reviews and decisions passing between functions.

lanes.note: Usually an operations engineer or OIM

Plans and executes the work through the CMMS

steps.name: Approve change
steps.threshold: Risk acceptance by band (ACE-RSK-POL-001 section 4); spend by the delegation schedule (ACE-FIN-POL-001)

flows.carries: Approved work package, parts and drawings
Briefing of operators in the affected area
Revised documents to the ONE repository

value.explain: Each implemented change is worth its average yearly benefit by class. While a change waits, that benefit is deferred; the cost of waiting is waiting days × benefit ÷ 365.

history.summary: First modelled issue, drawn from ACE-MOC-PRC-001. Implementation planned by the originator outside the maintenance schedule.
